fix: Wrap the Mode label and options in the same section structure used by model traits, constrain every section label to 26px, make the three separators real 9px flex items, and move the remaining four pixels into top content padding so the bottom-anchored panel matches Web exactly.
boundary: The first-row y offset remains four pixels because Web's model-trait group begins before the shared content padding while Lynx uses a uniform section box.
